physics_and_domain.tiled_irradiation: Opt-in reflection=tiled recomputes32receiver-row tiles against all visible donor faces each cooler-first sequential iteration. Original geometry/algebra, intrinsic bolometric LD and prefix ordering, no donor cutoffs/temperature cache, final mirroring. Dense reflection/defaults unchanged.
physics_and_domain.bounds: 40000faces per star,268435456 prepared pairs,0-32iterations; direct tile8-64 rows. Circular detached unspotted/nonpulsating original domain; q/spin/radius/state restrictions unchanged; unsupported states retain full CPU fallback/raise, not prior cuts.
physics_and_domain.fine_blackbody: Tiled mode allows40k symmetric BB faces with same bounded spectral chunks and fresh device-reflected temperatures. Original radiance default8192cap unchanged. CK04 fine profiles explicitly use original CPU radiance/LD.
physics_and_domain.eclipse: Fine curves use original CPU phase orientation/hulls/eclipse coverage, device surface integration; these are hybrid, not all-GPU geometry/coverage.
physics_and_domain.paired_grids: Explicit mesh_mode=paired with observation phases sets secondary factor equal to primary on every proposal/reference. Native temperature/radius adjustment and configured3-12deg clamps unchanged. Tested nominal2.5deg yields original inferredsecondary9.158225deg; paired sets both2.5.
physics_and_domain.finer_qualification: MeshResolutionCheck now accepts >=2deg original CPU references; below3deg requires paired mode. Failures remain outside original candidate handlers, including emergency penalties. No passing1e-4 certificate is asserted.
physics_and_domain.independent_reference: Owned CPU diagnostic composes original CPU mesh/gravity/intrinsic thermal, NumPy/Numba distance/gamma/LD, full donor sums in tiles and unchanged Observer/router. Coarse temperature controls and unmodified dense CPU whole-curve controls through2deg; separately labelled1.5deg reference avoids full matrices and remains finite.

scientific_assessment.accuracy_budget: Original sigma1e-4 with ln_f=-2 in finite comparisons; joint D<=0.1 corresponds to expected likelihood loss0.005 only for data generated by finite reference. No continuum/data-dependent error bound or assumed monotone convergence.
scientific_assessment.cases: Reflected partial and total BB, partial CK04/tableLD; both eclipses, contact-focused phases, ordering/repeats, phase shift/third light, explicit paired3/2/1.5deg surfaces. Prior broad cases and default semantics revalidated by full suite.
scientific_assessment.face_counts: 8916/20276/36180 per star at3/2/1.5deg in these fixtures.
scientific_assessment.remaining_accuracy: All2-to1.5deg finite pair distances exceed0.1. Smaller changes make the finer study useful but do not certify1.5deg or a continuum posterior. Next need adaptive geometry/quadrature or a justified surface error estimator, particularly at contacts.
scientific_assessment.fitting: Exactly same independent1.5deg finite truth/data, seed1010 sigma1e-4, T6500/5000K and inclination86.4deg. Original public LSQ16evaluations,2point/diff_step1e-4 at both3/2deg, one free primaryT with secondary=primary-1500; inclination fixed. Same original constraints, priors, third light, mapping/normalization and noise.
scientific_assessment.inference_limit: Fitted shifts combine noise and finite mesh; not calibrated parameter recovery, a bias estimate, or continuum inference. Finer experiment assesses changed MCMC density callbacks; current full suite retains prior public sampler replay. No finer mixing/convergence/ESS evidence.

timing_and_memory_conditions.matched: Within each independently restored profile unit: same affinity0-15/Nice10, threads1, FP64, identical host curves/densities and transfers. GPU driver explicitly selects both JAX CPU and GPU backends.
timing_and_memory_conditions.curve_timers: Binary and shared original Observer/engine constructors outside row timers, inside full driver wall. Original CPU row starts at prepared Observer.lc; independent CPU reference includes its Observer copy; hybrid rows include their per-call Observer setup/copy, fresh CPU/device state/bridges and all transfers. First-call costs include compilation incurred and may reuse previously compiled shapes; only partial BB has one complete repeat per mesh. Not a general throughput claim.
timing_and_memory_conditions.fitting_timers: Public constructor/setup/option copies/compile incurred/all callbacks/serialization included. Synthetic finite-reference data generation and auxiliary post-fit predictions/refinement comparisons/parity/list conversions are outside fit subtimers and inside complete profile wall. Each mesh has its own bounded unit; dataset seed/definition identical.
timing_and_memory_conditions.memory: Compiled temporary/argument/output accounting excludes runtime/compiler/allocator and CPU bridge memory. Original full visible distance matrix element count is an allocation size, not peak memory. All donors contribute; time remains quadratic despite bounded tiles.
timing_and_memory_conditions.development: CPU correctness profiles on cores16-19/Nice19 while production runs excluded from matched performance evidence.
